title: Medieval & Illuminated
description: Gold-leaf devotion, manuscript marginalia, and the luminous glow of the Middle Ages.
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: The Cloisters Apocalypse
items.medium: Tempera, gold, silver, and ink on parchment; later leather binding
items.description_narrative: This lavishly illustrated manuscript depicts scenes from the biblical Book of Revelation. Crafted with tempera, gold, silver, and ink on parchment, its pages exemplify the intricate artistry of medieval illumination.
items.tags: apocalypse, medieval, illumination, manuscript, religious art, gothic, french art

items.title: The Belles Heures of Jean de France, duc de Berry
items.medium: Tempera, gold, and ink on vellum
items.description_narrative: The Belles Heures of Jean de France, duc de Berry is a richly illuminated manuscript created by the Limbourg Brothers between 1405 and 1409. This masterpiece of early 15th-century art features detailed imagery executed in tempera, gold, and ink on vellum.
items.tags: illuminated manuscript, medieval, gothic, tempera, gold, vellum, devotional, french

items.title: The Unicorn Rests in a Garden (from the Unicorn Tapestries)
items.medium: Wool warp with wool, silk, silver, and gilt wefts
items.description_narrative: This tapestry depicts a unicorn, symbolizing purity and fertility, resting peacefully within an enclosed garden filled with a variety of plants. Woven with wool, silk, silver, and gilt wefts, it is the final panel from a celebrated series known as the Unicorn Tapestries.
items.tags: medieval, tapestry, unicorn, garden, millefleur, symbolic, franco-flemish

items.title: Book of Kells: Chi Rho Page
items.description_narrative: This page from the Book of Kells showcases the opening of the Gospel of Matthew, dominated by the highly ornamented Greek letters Chi and Rho, an abbreviation for Christ. Known for its extraordinary detail, the design incorporates spirals, interlace patterns, and animal motifs, exemplifying the peak of Insular illumination.
items.tags: insular art, medieval manuscript, illumination, chi rho, christian, gospels, intricate, celtic

items.title: Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry: January
items.description_narrative: This illuminated manuscript page captures the opulence of a New Year's feast at the court of Jean, Duc de Berry. It is celebrated for its intricate detail and the vivid portrayal of aristocratic life in the late Middle Ages.
items.tags: illuminated manuscript, medieval, court life, gothic, aristocracy, feasting, detailed, historical

items.title: Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry: February
items.description_narrative: This page from the Très Riches Heures du Duc de Berry depicts the month of February, illustrating peasants warming themselves by a fire and tending to livestock amidst a snow-covered landscape. It is celebrated for its exquisite detail, realistic portrayal of daily life, and early use of atmospheric perspective in manuscript illumination.
items.tags: medieval, manuscript, illumination, february, winter, daily life, gothic, realism

items.title: Bayeux Tapestry: Harold's Oath
items.description_narrative: This segment of the Bayeux Tapestry vividly illustrates Harold Godwinson swearing a solemn oath to William, Duke of Normandy, by touching holy relics. This critical act, presented from the Norman perspective, sets the stage for the later conflict and the Norman Conquest of England in 1066.
items.tags: medieval, embroidery, norman conquest, harold godwinson, william the conqueror, historical narrative, anglo-norman

items.title: Ghent Altarpiece: Adoration of the Mystic Lamb
items.description_narrative: Jan van Eyck's iconic Ghent Altarpiece, specifically the 'Adoration of the Mystic Lamb' panel, is a pivotal work in art history. This complex, multi-paneled artwork is renowned for its meticulous detail, vibrant colors, and profound theological narrative.
items.tags: religious art, altarpiece, early netherlandish, christianity, northern renaissance, adoration, sacred, detailed

items.title: Maestà
items.description_narrative: This monumental altarpiece depicts the Virgin Mary enthroned as the Queen of Heaven, holding the Christ Child and surrounded by a celestial court of angels and saints. A masterpiece of the Sienese School, it represents a pivotal moment in the development of early Italian Renaissance painting, blending Byzantine tradition with emerging naturalism.
items.tags: madonna and child, religious art, altarpiece, sienese school, trecento, devotional, byzantine influence, italian art

items.title: Santa Trinita Maestà
items.description_narrative: Cimabue's Santa Trinita Maestà depicts the Virgin Mary enthroned with the Christ Child, surrounded by angels and prophets, a monumental work reflecting Byzantine tradition. This altarpiece showcases an emerging sense of spatial depth and naturalism, signaling a pivotal shift towards the Italian Proto-Renaissance.
items.tags: religious, madonna and child, altarpiece, byzantine influence, proto-renaissance, italian, panel painting

items.title: Annunciation
items.description_narrative: Simone Martini's Annunciation depicts the pivotal moment when the Archangel Gabriel informs the Virgin Mary that she will conceive Jesus, a central event in Christian theology. The work is renowned for its elegant lines, delicate figures, and sophisticated use of gold leaf, characteristic of the Sienese School.
items.tags: annunciation, virgin mary, archangel gabriel, religious art, gothic, sienese school, panel painting, sacred

items.title: Annunciation
items.description_narrative: Fra Angelico masterfully depicts the pivotal moment of the Annunciation, where the Archangel Gabriel conveys the divine message to the Virgin Mary. The scene is imbued with serene beauty and spiritual grace, characterized by the artist's use of radiant colors and delicate forms.
items.tags: early renaissance, christian art, religious, annunciation, mary, gabriel, italian, spiritual

items.title: Sainte-Chapelle Stained Glass
items.description_narrative: The Sainte-Chapelle Stained Glass presents an immersive visual experience, with monumental windows that transform light into a kaleidoscope of color. These intricate panels narrate over 1,113 biblical scenes, illustrating divine history and the chapel's sacred purpose.
items.tags: stained glass, gothic, religious, biblical, medieval, architecture, french
